from pathlib import Path
path=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c35101ef.py')
code='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))\n    # The non-background pattern is the template; isolated marker cells share its center.\n    from collections import Counter\n    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)\n    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    coords = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]\n    # Find the template as the largest connected component, excluding isolated markers.\n    seen=set(); comps=[]\n    for r,c in coords:\n        if (r,c) in seen: continue\n        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]\n        while stack:\n            y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))\n            for q in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):\n                if q in coords and q not in seen: seen.add(q); stack.append(q)\n        comps.append(comp)\n    template=max(comps,key=len)\n    r0=min(r for r,c in template); r1=max(r for r,c in template)\n    c0=min(c for r,c in template); c1=max(c for r,c in template)\n    shape=[[grid[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(c1-c0+1)] for i in range(r1-r0+1)]\n    # Every other non-background singleton marks the template center.\n    out=[row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r,row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c,v in enumerate(row):\n            if v != bg and (r,c) not in template:\n                out[r][c]=bg\n                for i,srow in enumerate(shape):\n                    for j,color in enumerate(srow):\n                        y=r+i-(len(shape)//2); x=c+j-(len(srow)//2)\n                        if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and color!=bg: out[y][x]=color\n    return out\n'''
